preserved_conflicts: SR151 is DRC-only at 9144 confirmed / 4410 deaths / 2418 recovered. The separately dated Uganda closeout 20/2/18 gives COD|UGA 9164/4412/2436; Kenya and France remain outside this scope.

Cross-edition base (pages 1-3): SR151 prints 9144 cumulative confirmed and 79 new. The promoted SR150 (INRB/INSP/UMIE repository copy) is 9066, so the cumulative movement is +78 against 79 printed new. INSP's own SR150 upload (WordPress post 25713, posted 2026-10-14) prints 9065 on its cover tile and province table (Haut-Uele 382) but 9066 in its narrative and zone table; 9065 + 79 = 9144, so SR151's base matches INSP's cover figure. At zone level the missing case sits in Ituri, not Haut-Uele: Adja falls from 12 to 11 confirmed (deaths 1; CFR 8.3% to 9.1%) with no new case and no stated reclassification, Ituri moves 6695 to 6734 (+39) against 40 new, and Haut-Uele moves 383 to 391 (+8) against 8 new. Every other zone moves by its printed daily cells. Neither edition is repaired; SR150 stays at 9066.
Deaths and recoveries move cleanly: 4381 to 4410 (+29) and 2389 to 2418 (+29). The 24-hour death movement is 29: 18 community plus 11 intra-CTE (cover: 8 CTE deaths in Ituri, 3 in Nord-Kivu).

Source: INSP WordPress post 25716 (published 2026-10-14T08:17:07Z, modified 2026-10-14T08:17:12Z); PDF media 25717 uploaded 2026-10-14T08:16:09Z. The edition label 12/10/2026, Tableaux 1-4 ('au 12 octobre 2026') and the header report date 12 October set data_as_of 2026-10-12; the header publication date is 13 October.

The daily 79 confirmations are not the affected-zone footprint: cover and Tableau 1 print 65/167 historically affected zones. This edition prints no currently-affected column (SR150: 57/167). The same 65 named zones remain present; no new zone. 20 zones report new confirmations.

The 493 Ituri deaths printed as A ventiler remain unallocated: 3917 named zone deaths plus 493 close on 4410. Blank daily cells remain null; printed zeros remain zero. Logo and Mutwanga print a blank new-case cell with one intra-CTE death each.

Alerts (pages 4-5): Tableau 3 totals 3100 alerts, the prose 3098. Printed 98.3% verified is 3047/3100; 53 live alerts are neither validated nor invalidated (Haut-Uele 51 of 142, Ituri 2). Printed 16.8% validated is 522/3100, over all alerts rather than verified ones. Sud-Ubangi prints ND. Not repaired.

Contacts: 77.6% is 25469/32811 across five reporting provinces; Sud-Ubangi transmitted no data and Sud-Kivu is not listed. Ituri contacts under follow-up rise from 8236 to 13415, so the fall from 79.5% mixes a denominator change with coverage.

Nord-Kivu (page 7): 445 hospitalized (176 confirmed, 269 suspects), 333 in CTE/CT for 374 beds (printed 89.0%) and 112 (25.2%) outside CTE/CT; 333+112=445 reconciles. The 89.0% is a CTE/CT-only rate and the census exceeds the bed count, so no all-census occupancy is inferred.

Ituri (page 7) prints 382 patients at 36.0% occupancy with no bed denominator; SR150's 1015 beds would give 37.6%, so neither that denominator nor a back-calculated one is used. 358/368 patients fed hot meals uses a 368 base against the 382 census.

Haut-Uele deaths: the care panel (page 7) reports 2 confirmed deaths (Pawa and Wamba) and 1 suspect death, but Tableau 2 (page 3) records one Haut-Uele confirmed death (Pawa, community) and no intra-CTE death, Wamba stays at 45 deaths, and the cover places the 11 CTE deaths in Ituri (8) and Nord-Kivu (3). Not repaired.

Isolation: the cover 899 equals the five provincial stocks 382+445+45+13+14, which split 330 confirmed and 569 suspects; no national split is printed. Stocks do not follow from SR150 plus same-day flows: Ituri 337+100-75=362 vs 382, Nord-Kivu 471+86-82=475 vs 445, Haut-Uele 45+6-9=42 vs 45, Tshopo 15+3-1=17 vs 13. Not repaired.

PoE/PoC (page 5): Tableau 4 covers Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele (7 alerts 4/1/1/0/1, 4 bodies, 3 validated suspects). The prose lists the 7 alerts as Ituri 4, Nord-Kivu 1, Sud-Kivu 1 and Tanganyika 1, and says all were investigated and transferred to CTE, while the table prints 33.3% suspect transfer, 0.0% investigated within 4 h and 0.0% bodies swabbed in Sud-Kivu. Tanganyika is not an affected province and no case is inferred. Both retained.
Laboratory (page 6): Bas-Uele prints '3 3 nouveaux echantillons'; read as 3 because 227+141+36+12+3 = 419 matches the cover. Positivity 79/419 = 18.9%.
SMSPS challenge (page 9) says Mandima concentrates 32% of the day's notified cases; Tableau 2 gives Mandima 11 of Ituri's 40 (27.5%) and 11 of 79 nationally (13.9%). Not repaired.
Cover (page 1): the text layer carries white-on-white '246 Aires de sante touchees Sur 3104 (7,9%)' that does not render; no health-area footprint is promoted.

Figure 1 is an onset-date plot of 7284 confirmed cases with onset date and vital status, not a cumulative count; bar heights are not reconstructed. Figure 2 maps are not a statistical source, though the 24 h panel's 20 affected zones and legend bins agree with Tableau 2.
Bas-Uele suspect isolation sites include Bondo, Likati and Titule, outside the confirmed-case zone table; these hold suspects only and add no affected zone.

Tshopo care bullet: 443 people have received experimental treatment since the start (41 confirmed, 402 post-exposure prophylaxis); the geographic scope is not stated. Ituri reports continued research on Ervebo efficacy against BDBV. Neither is an efficacy signal.
Dakwa retains its explicitly disclosed facility-coordinate proxy; its health-zone boundary and model centroid are still unverified.
Recoveries: cover 29 matches the cumulative DRC increase 2389 to 2418 and the provincial care panels 13+13+2+1; Ituri cumulative 1895 to 1908.
